title: Sand tiger shark pups fight to the death before birth
subject: sand tiger shark

scenes.text: Some shark pups fight to the death before they are born.
A mother sand tiger shark has two wombs, and roughly a dozen embryos begin growing inside.
About five months in, the biggest embryo in each womb starts attacking its smaller siblings.
Then it eats the mother's unfertilized eggs too.
Only two pups survive, one from each womb, and each is about a meter long at birth.
So this shark is born ready. It already won its first fight.

description:
Some shark pups fight to the death before they are born.
A sand tiger shark starts with roughly a dozen embryos, but only two are born.
Would you survive the womb?
first_comment: Nature is brutal. What's the wildest animal birth you know?
